'''David Manuki Vardanyan''' ({{langx|hy|Դավիթ Մանուկի Վարդանյան}}; 12 February 1950 – 27 May 2022) was an Armenian politician. A member of the [[National Democratic Union (Armenia)|National Democratic Union]], he was a member of the [[Supreme Soviet of the Armenian Soviet Socialist Republic|Supreme Council of Armenia]] from 1990 to 1995 and of the [[National Assembly (Armenia)|National Assembly of Armenia]] from 1995 to 1999.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.parliament.am/archive/deputies.php?sel=details&ID=325&lang=eng|title=David VARDANYAN|work=National Assembly of the Republic of Armenia}}</ref> 

Vardanyan died on 27 May 2022, at the age of 72.<ref>{{cite news |last= |first= |date=28 May 2022|title=Մահացել է «Ղարաբաղ» կոմիտեի անդամ Դավիթ Վարդանյանը|trans-title= |url=https://www.lragir.am/2022/05/28/719938/|language=Armenian|work=Lragir.am|location= |access-date=28 May 2022}}</ref>
